newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bankruptcies rise nine pct through August.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bankruptcies rise nine pct through August.

text.p: Swiss commercial bankruptcies rose 9.0 percent from January through end-August compared with the same period in 1995.

Schweizerischer Verband Creditreform, a bureau that gives banks information on the creditworthiness of borrowers, said 2,752 commercial bankruptcy proceedings had been registered in the first eight months of the year compared with 2,525 in the same 1995 period.
Including non-firm bankruptcy proceedings, total bankruptcy cases rose 2.1 percent to 6,601 versus 6,466 last year.
